name: 21558-varlenprefill-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- an ungated mirror of the licence-gated meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, same weights.
architecture: Dense bf16 decoder, LlamaForCausalLM: 8.03 B parameters, ~16.1 GB of bf16 weights over 4 safetensors shards, 128 KiB of bf16 KV per token.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=50, no warmup and no cooldown, bounded at 50 requests with a 900 s safety cap. Streams equal requests, so each stream issues exactly one and the whole population is offered at once.
workload: GuideLLM `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets; prompt length uniform over [1000, 19000] tokens, mean 10000, output exactly 1 token; fresh Faker text per request, so no two share a prefix. Sampling temperature 0.0, `request_format: plain` (no chat template), static seed 21558.
purpose: A long-document classifier returning one-token verdicts for 50 simultaneous users on a single 8-billion-parameter model GPU.
launch:
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

max-num-seqs: 1

# PINNED, not a default written down: an engine built through the async path resolves this to the
# library default of 2048, a quarter of what `vllm serve` resolves to on this card. Do not drop it.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

enable-chunked-prefill: true
enable-prefix-caching: true

max-model-len: 20480
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
